cases.detail: IEEE 1800-2023 21.3.4.3 permits a string expression as the scan format. Verilator 5.052 requires a format string literal and rejects both a string variable and a string method expression with "unexpected IDENTIFIER, expecting STRING". The string-source case with a literal format remains enabled.
